## Building the Lineage Chain

Let me trace all the relationships systematically:

**From the given facts:**
- Barbara → Sarah (Barbara is Sarah's ancestor)
- Sarah → Randy (Randy is Sarah's descendant, so Sarah is Randy's ancestor)
- Randy → Lisa (Randy is Lisa's ancestor)
- Lisa → Martha (Lisa is Martha's ancestor)
- Martha → Timothy (Timothy is Martha's descendant)
- Timothy → Dennis (Timothy is Dennis's ancestor)
- Dennis → Elizabeth (Dennis is Elizabeth's ancestor)

**Complete chain:**
$$\text{Barbara} \rightarrow \text{Sarah} \rightarrow \text{Randy} \rightarrow \text{Lisa} \rightarrow \text{Martha} \rightarrow \text{Timothy} \rightarrow \text{Dennis} \rightarrow \text{Elizabeth}$$

## Conclusion

Barbara is at the top of the chain and Elizabeth is at the bottom. This means **Elizabeth is Barbara's descendant**.
